research_question: Does the current official BPS Sumatera Barat CSA table catalog under the construction-related subject expose any construction-establishment or qualification table with a source-native 2005 period that can close the post-update historical evidence gap?

relevance_contract.reason: The CSA subject label itself contains the word Konstruksi and therefore cannot be used to establish table-level construction relevance. Relevance is determined from the table's own source-native title.

bounded_inference.claim_scope: Current CSA catalog inventory under Sumatera Barat subject 559 only.
bounded_inference.preferred_remaining_frontier: Contemporaneous official BPS publication/Deep Search surfaces, especially Book II 05230.0610 or another official 2005-era reproduction of Sumatera Barat post-update qualification counts.

probe_provenance.note: The final audit run used title-only relevance after an earlier experimental filter was found to be confounded by the subject label containing 'Konstruksi'. Only the corrected final run is canonical.
